purpose: Keep identity, tenancy, entrants, harnesses, claims, competition, review, publication, and evidence independently verifiable.

compatibility.rule: Presentation may change; digest-bound ids, Receipt bytes, and provenance do not.

identifier_contract.uniqueness: globally unique across all tenants and entity types
identifier_contract.immutability: an identifier is never recycled, renamed, or reassigned
identifier_contract.comparison: lowercase ASCII prefix, uppercase ASCII ULID, byte-exact; split on final underscore

digest_document.rule: The digest covers canonical bytes whose media type and canonicalization version are explicit; a mutable URL is never sufficient.

deletion_receipt_tombstone.rule: After erasure this restricted payload-free shape replaces Receipt, resolves deletion refs forever, and destroys identity/subject/payload/keys; public digest Publication is optional.

participant_binding.rule: participant_ref+participant_version resolve immutable entrant bytes; Match/Run require seat, other scopes omit it

seed_or_fixture_binding.rule: The commitment is frozen before execution and its reveal is receipt-bound.

attestation.rule: attested is a derived value, never caller authority
attestation.true_only_when: independently_attested plus signed claim-bound Receipts from active independent authority with accepted conflict Review; unsigned never attests
independent_signer_constraints: signer is an active approved reviewer enrolled before Receipt creation
compare signer, subject, owner, producer, conflict reviewer; overlap/unresolved fails
provider/subject evidence reaches configured or api_reported, never independently_attested

rules: only active at Receipt creation attests
revocation blocks new attestations and appends Receipt; history stays
conflict refs point backward in a finite DAG; cycle/missing fails

bootstrap_contract.scope: Only the first reviewer-authority enrollment Review may omit conflict_check_ref, and only while no reviewer authority exists.
bootstrap_contract.launch_account_designation: launch-Account = active Account version named with its owner Builder version in Organization.founding_authority_manifest_ref before first enrollment; later edits/current lookup invalid
bootstrap_contract.founder_ceremony_rule: authority_ceremony requires >=2 designated Account signatures with distinct owner Builders; no signer owner overlaps enrolled owner, subject, producer, or other signer; boundary binds authority, key, founding manifest, evidence, independence, window
bootstrap_contract.post_bootstrap_rule: After first enrollment every Review requires conflict_check_ref; the exception cannot recur.
bootstrap_contract.ordering_rule: Per Organization order by created_at then digest; atomic first wins. Require created_at <= signed_at <= effective_from.

field_constraints.owner_ref: typed exact owner version used in every overlap check
field_constraints.public_key_ref: digest_document of key bytes and algorithm

signer_authority_record_schema.reference_rule: signer_authority_record refs carry authority_id+version; current-authority lookup invalid

proof_boundary.rule: proves and does_not_prove are non-empty versioned claim vocabularies; claim_refs resolve the exact immutable claims evaluated by the Receipt

reference_typing.rule: Every _ref/_refs is mapped, named, or digest_document; untyped fails. Bare refs to versioned entities resolve one immutable version; without a companion version the value is {entity_ref,entity_version}. Mutable-current lookup is invalid.
reference_typing.entity_version_rule: entity_version = required version, else sha256(canonical immutable snapshot with canonicalization_version). Changes append snapshot+transition Receipt naming prior/next; stable ID/current lookup invalid.

entity_reference_patterns.match_id|match_ref|match_refs|supersedes: the same entity type as the source unless the entity contract says otherwise

typed_union_fields.subject_ref: entity_kind + entity_ref + entity_version; entity_kind is a canonical entity or governed signer_authority_record
typed_union_fields.authority_ref|reviewer_authority_ref|app: authority_kind + authority_ref + authority_version; authority_kind is Account, Builder, Creator, Organization, or approved independent reviewer authority
typed_union_fields.owner_ref: authority_kind + authority_ref + authority_version; authority_kind is Builder or Account
typed_union_fields.competition_scope_ref: competition_kind + competition_ref + competition_version; competition_kind is League, Season, or Tournament
typed_union_fields.sponsor_refs: array whose members are Organization references or digest_document sponsor declarations
typed_union_fields.finding_refs: array of digest_document finding records or Receipt references
typed_union_fields.artifact_refs: array of digest_document artifact bindings or Receipt references

competition_scope_rules_binding.admission_rule: Every Match counted by a scope must resolve a RulesVersion whose rules_digest sha256 exactly equals scope.ruleset_ref.sha256.
competition_scope_rules_binding.compatibility_exception: A mismatch is allowed only through an immutable compatibility entry inside the frozen standing contract that names both rules digests, the exact normalization formula, reviewer authority, and accepted review Receipt.
competition_scope_rules_binding.verification_rule: Scope verification recomputes eligibility, results, standings, and titles only from Matches satisfying the exact digest equality or the accepted compatibility exception; otherwise verification fails closed.

field_constraints.deletion_authority_receipt_ref: account_deletion binding exact Account version, tenant scope, actor, window; frozen at deletion_requested
field_constraints.deletion_receipt_ref: account_deletion binding completion and frozen deletion_authority_receipt_ref

Account.deleted_record_shape: Overrides required_fields at deleted: retain account_id,state,created_at,deletion authority+completion refs,computed entity_version; destroy identity digest,tenant/builder refs,payload,keys.

field_constraints.export_receipt_ref: account_export produced by this Tenant or an authorizing Account; boundary binds exact Tenant version and export scope
field_constraints.deletion_authority_receipt_ref: account_deletion for Account authority or review_decision for Organization authority; boundary names this Tenant and deletion scope

Tenant.deleted_record_shape: Overrides required_fields at deleted: retain tenant_id,state,created_at,deletion authority+completion refs,computed entity_version; destroy authority/organization refs,payload,keys.

field_constraints.version: immutable monotonic snapshot; changes append a version

field_constraints.founding_authority_manifest_ref: pre-enrollment digest_document naming exact Organization, launch Account+owner Builder versions, time, purpose, key bindings, canonicalization

field_constraints.harness_refs: array of one or more immutable Harness references; every referenced harness version and artifact digest is bound into each competitive receipt
field_constraints.attestation: object {attested:boolean,evaluated_claims:array of exact ModelClaim or ProviderClaim refs,attestation_receipt_refs:array}; when no claims exist it is exactly {attested:false,evaluated_claims:[],attestation_receipt_refs:[]}

field_constraints.attestation_receipt_refs: non-empty immutable Receipt-ref array when attested=true; every member satisfies binding_contracts.attestation
non-empty immutable Receipt-ref array when attested=true; every member satisfies binding_contracts.attestation

field_constraints.artifact_digest: digest_document over the canonical immutable harness manifest

field_constraints.member_bindings: array of typed immutable bindings whose kind is builder, agent, harness, or coach and whose referenced version is explicit
field_constraints.digest: digest_document over the canonical immutable roster manifest
field_constraints.rules_acknowledgement_ref: Receipt of type acknowledgement whose subject_ref resolves this exact RosterVersion and whose proof_boundary names the exact RulesVersion or competition scope

variation_contract.run_rule: A differing Run digest matches one member and binds its Receipt/Review; else fail.

field_constraints.environment_digest: digest_document binding covering map, runtime, dependency, and referee execution artifacts
field_constraints.rules_digest: digest_document over canonical RulesVersion including allowed_environment_variations but omitting rules_digest; canonicalization_version fixes omission+serialization; blanking/fixed-point hashing forbidden
field_constraints.referee_digest: digest_document binding covering the exact adjudicator implementation and canonicalization version
field_constraints.suspension_receipt_ref: review_decision Receipt created for the suspension
field_constraints.revocation_receipt_ref: signed revocation Receipt binding this RulesVersion and reason

field_constraints.participant_bindings: array of at least two participant_binding objects
field_constraints.seat_bindings: authoritative bijection from participant binding to an allowed seat in the frozen RulesVersion; participant_binding.seat is a denormalized copy that must equal seat_bindings exactly or validation fails
field_constraints.run_coverage: At running, played_unverified, and verified, each participant_binding has at least one Run and every Run.participant_binding byte-equals one seat_bindings member.
field_constraints.budget_profile_ref: immutable digest-bound budget and timeout profile
field_constraints.receipt_ref: played_unverified: match_transcript; verified: replay_verdict|match_decision; terminal: match_decision
field_constraints.tenant_transcript_receipt_refs: cross-tenant redacted child match_transcript per participant Tenant; each binds canonical transcript_ref by parent_receipt_refs+digest chain; no other-Tenant payload

field_constraints.award_receipt_ref: Receipt of type title_award whose subject_ref resolves this exact Title and whose proof_boundary names holder_ref, result_ref, title_policy_digest, and competition_scope_ref

field_constraints.permission_profile_ref: must equal the parent Match permission_profile_ref exactly; any deviation is permanently ineligible for Run verified state, even when recorded by human_intervention Receipt
field_constraints.budget_profile_ref: must equal the parent Match budget_profile_ref exactly; any deviation is permanently ineligible for Run verified state, even when recorded by human_intervention Receipt
field_constraints.environment_digest: equals parent digest or one allowed variation with bound human_intervention Receipt and accepted Review
field_constraints.operator_tenant_ref: required only for a resolved contained_hosted_runner Agent; resolves its dedicated operator Tenant and grants no customer-Tenant authority
field_constraints.transcript_ref: Match-produced match_transcript whose subject is parent Match and boundary binds exact Run version+transcript digest
field_constraints.receipt_ref: completed_unverified=match_transcript; verified=replay_verdict; failed=review_decision; cancelled|revoked=revocation; allowed producer and boundary bind exact Run version

field_constraints.source_run_refs: this Match's immutable Runs; verified covers each participant with a verified Run
field_constraints.receipt_ref: replay_verdict for verification evidence or match_decision for void/supersession authority

Result.projection_rule: Match.result_ref resolves the latest non-superseded Result in its append-only lineage; superseded results remain addressable by their immutable IDs.

field_constraints.conflict_check_ref: required except for the signer_authority_lifecycle bootstrap case
field_constraints.founder_ceremony_receipt_ref: allowed only for that single bootstrap case

field_constraints.public_route: after rejecting percent encoding and any decoded '.' or '..' segment, canonical BuilderWars HTTPS path matches ^/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9/_-]{0,511}$; no query/fragment; inert until published, domain ownership verified, and source-bound deployment Receipt exists
field_constraints.approver_authority_ref: exact authority version in approval publication Receipt boundary
field_constraints.publisher_authority_ref: exact authority version in deployment Receipt boundary; distinct/non-overlapping with approver

field_constraints.signature: valid if present; required for attestation and verification-critical receipt types; unsigned other receipts may prove only their non-attestation boundary
field_constraints.signatures: authority_ceremony only: >=2 {signer_ref,signature,signed_at} over identical bytes; designated Account+owner Builder versions are pairwise distinct and do not overlap enrolled owner
field_constraints.tenant_id: required for every private_receipt_type and forbidden from granting cross-tenant authority; public digest-only derivatives use a new Publication Receipt rather than deleting this binding
field_constraints.conflict_check_ref: required when the Receipt is used to derive attested=true and must resolve an accepted independent Review

relationship_cardinality_contract.source_max: targets allowed per source; null is unbounded
relationship_cardinality_contract.target_max: sources allowed per target; null is unbounded
relationship_cardinality_contract.state_scope: states where minima apply; otherwise minima are zero but maxima and refs still apply

state_scope.target_min_applies_when: Tenant.state in active|suspended and Tenant.organization_ref is absent; an Organization-managed Tenant instead requires one exact versioned Organization authority record

required_relationships.evidence: identity-provider subject binding plus application authority record
entrant manifest with every harness version and artifact digest
versioned creator authority record bound to creator_refs

state_scope.source_min_applies_when: Game.lifecycle_state is one of submitted, sandboxed, verified, exhibition, ranked, seasonal, official, or suspended

required_relationships.evidence: immutable rules, referee, and environment digests
rules_version_id in match header and receipt
typed participant bindings in match header and receipt
result source-run set and scoring-contract digest
title policy and competition scope digest

state_scope.source_min_applies_when: Review subject is League, Season, or Tournament

required_relationships.evidence: rights-reviewed redacted artifact and publication receipt

receipt_producer_contract.rule: Each Receipt has one allowed immutable producer; parent_receipt_refs add lineage, not authority.
receipt_producer_contract.validation: Type, subject, boundary, signer, and producer must agree; invalid Receipts confer no state.

receipt_type_rules.title_award: subject_ref resolves Title; proof_boundary names the exact scope, holder, Result, title policy digest, and award authority
receipt_type_rules.acknowledgement: subject_ref resolves RosterVersion or RulesVersion; proof_boundary names the acknowledging Team or Builder, exact digest, authority, and effective competition scope
receipt_type_rules.authority_ceremony: subject is first reviewer-authority enrollment; boundary binds the Organization founding_authority_manifest_ref, at least two designated launch-Account versions, their distinct owner Builder versions, enrolled authority owner, key, evidence manifest, independence and non-overlap declarations, and window; valid only once
receipt_type_rules.tenant_cleanup: subject is Tenant; boundary binds deletion_authority_receipt_ref and cleanup manifest; deterministic cleanup may finalize after authority Accounts are deleted
receipt_type_rules.private_receipts: receipt.private_receipt_types require tenant_id and remain private unless a distinct rights-reviewed Publication emits a redacted digest-only public Receipt

receipt_producer_contract.attestation_rule: Claim-produced provider_report evidence never self-attests; only independent signer constraints elevate claims.

lifecycle_contracts.verified_state_guard: Verified Match/Run/Result uses accepted, non-suspended/revoked/superseded RulesVersion. Receipts pass digest,producer,boundary,tenant,revocation,conflict,signature checks; match_decision,replay_verdict,review_decision,revocation are signed; unsigned non-attestation types allowed. Disqualified/voided/revoked/superseded fails.

signer_authority_record.guards: Only active signs; transitions append signed receipts, effective windows never overlap, rotated/revoked never reactivate.

Game.guards: Every transition records actor authority, reason, prior state, next state, source version, and a receipt. The admission tier elevations submitted->sandboxed, sandboxed->verified, verified->exhibition, exhibition->ranked, ranked->seasonal, and seasonal->official each require a governing accepted Review for that exact transition. A suspended Game resumes only to its receipt-bound pre-suspension tier; elevation to another tier requires a separate governing Review and transition receipt.

scheduled: all frozen participant, rules, environment, seat, seed, permission, and budget bindings
running: all frozen participant, rules, environment, seat, seed, permission, and budget bindings

Match.guards: A transition appends evidence and never rewrites a prior receipt; no transition returns from a terminal state.

Run.guards: Run.verified requires its parent Match to be played_unverified or verified, exact equality with the parent permission and budget bindings, and the global verified_state_guard. A Run whose participant resolves an Agent with execution_class contained_hosted_runner cannot enter running until operator_tenant_ref resolves one active dedicated platform-operator Tenant.

voided|superseded: when superseded, a successor Result names this Result via supersedes_ref

Result.guards: Result.verified requires parent Match verified, every source Run verified, source_run_refs coverage of every participant_binding, and the global verified_state_guard.

RulesVersion.guards: Accepted states need accepted conflict Review; post-suspension re-admission needs a newer Review than suspension_receipt_ref; revoked/superseded enter no Match.

League.guards: Each transition appends review_decision with actor/reason/prior/next/version. Verified recomputes accepted Match/Result Receipts and passes verified_state_guard.

Season.guards: Each transition appends review_decision with actor/reason/prior/next/version. Verified recomputes frozen schedule/standings from accepted Match/Result Receipts and passes verified_state_guard.

Tournament.guards: Each transition appends review_decision with actor/reason/prior/next/version. Verified recomputes manifest/bracket from accepted Match/Result Receipts and passes verified_state_guard.

Title.guards: Title.verified requires a verified source Result inside the exact title policy scope and the global verified_state_guard to pass.

Appeal.guards: The decision Review must be conflict-checked and independent of the appealed decision; upheld, denied, and withdrawn are terminal and do not rewrite the appealed receipt.

Account_and_Tenant.guards: Entering deletion_requested freezes deletion_authority_receipt_ref. The Tenant-produced tenant_cleanup Receipt may finalize deletion after Account deletion. Reversal needs the frozen authority or an accepted Review plus review_decision and is forbidden after deleted; deleted records never reactivate.

Publication.guards: Approval requires approver_authority_ref in the publication Receipt boundary. Publication requires publisher_authority_ref in the deployment Receipt boundary. The two exact authority records must be distinct and pass the attestation overlap check; revocation preserves the old receipt while the public projection fails closed.

lifecycle_contracts.decision_receipt_rule: Match cancellation/disqualification and Match/Result void/supersession use match_decision; Game, Run failed, and League/Season/Tournament transitions use review_decision; Run cancellation and Run/other revocations use revocation; appeals use appeal_decision. Producer, subject, boundary, type agree.

decision_rules: accepted, rejected, and revoked are terminal for one Review record
incomplete and repair_required never mutate in place; a later Review must name supersedes_ref and bind a new evidence_manifest_digest
a superseding Review preserves the earlier decision Receipt and conflict check

tenant_and_privacy_contract.public_only_by_publication: Only a rights-reviewed, redacted, digest-bound Publication makes a subject public.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.tenant_rule: Every tenant-owned private record carries one tenant_id; Tenant is the isolation root. Account authority is a separate versioned many-to-many relation. Private operations and idempotency resolve one Tenant.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.public_registry_identity_rule: Agent, Harness, ModelClaim, and ProviderClaim are tenant-free public metadata with no private bytes. Private artifacts, evidence, session, and personal data live in tenant-scoped Receipts or digest-bound tenant artifacts; erasure detaches them but preserves non-personal lineage.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.credential_rule: Passwords, cookies, tokens, API keys, and subscription credentials are never fields or evidence.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.erasure_rule: Deletion removes/detaches private payloads and revokes keys. Public residue is non-personal digest-only Publication; private deletion lineage follows deletion_lineage_exception_rule.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.deletion_lineage_exception_rule: At deleted destroy payload+keys; keep restricted deletion_receipt_tombstone forever so refs resolve. Public digest Publication is optional and not the tombstone.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.public_attestation_verification_rule: Public Agent/Harness/ModelClaim/ProviderClaim attestations expose only rights-reviewed digest Publication derivatives linked to private attestation Receipts; private receipts and tenant IDs remain undisclosed.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.historical_rule: Revocation, supersession, disqualification, appeal, deletion, and rollback append Receipts; historical match bytes never change.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.authority_rule: Authentication, tenancy, competition, review, publication, and launch are distinct grants.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.platform_operator_tenant_rule: A contained_hosted_runner Run requires operator_tenant_ref to one active dedicated operator Tenant before running; it grants no customer-Tenant access.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.appeal_tenancy_rule: Appeal.tenant_id resolves the appellant's authorized Tenant, not Account ownership. Account-less appellants use an Organization-managed Tenant whose versioned authority names them; otherwise fail closed.
tenant_and_privacy_contract.receipt_tenancy_rule: Private Receipt has one tenant_id. Cross-tenant transcript_ref is canonical in operator evidence Tenant; per-Tenant redacted children bind it by parent_receipt_refs+digest chain, copy no other-Tenant payload/id; public use needs Publication.

match_receipt_minimum_binding_scope: Minimums bind the immutable match_transcript+replay_verdict+match_decision bundle collectively; early transcript need not contain a future verdict, but final verified/terminal bundle binds all without contradiction.
match_receipt_minimum_bindings: exact roster version where a team competes
harness artifact digests for every Agent participant
model and provider claims with evidence classes
environment digest covering map, runtime, dependencies, and referee execution artifacts
prohibited_conflations: authentication equals tenant, competition, review, publication, or launch authority
review accepted equals published or launched
self-declared model label equals independent model attestation
prohibited_implication_rule: Absent an exact versioned Receipt grant, no entity implies identity, ownership, rights, admission, ranking, verification, publication, launch, subscription, credential custody, cross-tenant authority, or compatibility. proof_boundary and prohibited_conflations fail closed.
